owner_determination.contract_owner: Handshake-wide plugin/extension contract in Master Spec 5.1.3/5.1.5/5.2, capability registry 11.1, MEX 11.8, ResourceBroker and CKC asset authority. No verified canonical executable class named PluginPlatform or equivalent complete manager.
owner_determination.planned_gap: The inspected source does not establish a connected manifest validation/install/version/consent activation/extension registration/sandbox invoke/revoke/update/remove lifecycle. Shared substrates are concrete reuse seams, not proof that a complete platform already exists.
owner_determination.studio_boundary: ScorePlugin owns optional native audio provider processing and foreign-resource lifecycle only. It must consume host-neutral typed ports; it must not own a private extension catalog, scheduler, library, capability registry, authoritative store or manual.

execution_paths.observed: MexRegistry loads mechanical_engines.json into engine/operation maps. Workflow construction installs shell, media downloader and calendar sync adapters. This is engine registration, not an installed plugin manifest/version lifecycle.

EngineAdapter is a trusted async invoke trait. Runtime checks gates then directly awaits the selected adapter. Shell delegates to TerminalService with timeout/output limits and capability context. Generic adapter isolation and deadline cancellation do not follow solely from this trait or BudgetGate.

GatedMcpClient resolves configured tools, checks shared capabilities and consent/session grants. Unknown tools are denied; alias ambiguity errors. Tool discovery is not install/update/remove ownership, and gate admission is not executable sandbox proof.

Shared adapters expose spawn/exec/fs_bind/net_policy/kill. ProcessSpec carries binds/network/resources/caps. Optional resource limits may be None/unlimited. Registry rejects unapproved Windows native jail selection. LedgerDecorator spawns first then writes START; failed recording returns error without a compensating kill in this inspected path.

Authority API describes shared account/principal/session/AccessSpace/capability/grant ResourceBroker boundaries and delegates protected-resource authorization. Native EditorSurface seam explicitly labels itself a design-only stub with no existing runtime caller. Complete installed plugin UI, inspection and manual contribution registration is not established by these excerpts.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.finding: Existing shared contracts and runtime substrates do not establish a complete executable plugin lifecycle owner; building that lifecycle privately in Studio would fork authority.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.counterexample: An update changes plugin entry points or requested network domains while an old activated contribution remains registered. Engine registration and discovery alone provide no inspected uninstall/revoke transaction that removes that contribution and invalidates its grants.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.remediation: Declare one Handshake-wide owner for manifest identity/version, installation, contribution registration and lifecycle. Studio local registry UI must be a projection/consumer of that owner. Keep ScorePlugin limited to audio processing ports and provider lifecycle.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.future_MT_proof: Actual production install -> grant -> activate -> contribution invocation -> grant revoke -> update/remove path, fresh registry read, no stale contribution or authority; failed install rollback and concurrent version activation. Foundation fixtures cannot substitute for installed runtime proof.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.finding: MEX BudgetGate validates presence/shape of limits; generic EngineAdapter invocation does not itself enforce runtime time/memory/queue/process ceilings or sandbox isolation.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.counterexample: A registered adapter accepts a bounded PlannedOperation but its invoke never returns or allocates beyond budget. Admission can succeed while no generic termination boundary is visible in the inspected invoke path. This is a source counterexample, not an observed runaway process.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.remediation: Shared platform must translate admitted limits into enforced worker/process limits, cancellation and reclamation; reject omitted required limits. Preserve provider-specific TerminalService controls while adding the common lifecycle contract.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.future_MT_proof: Hanging, allocating and queue-flooding plugin cases produce typed budget outcomes; bounded cancel/reclaim; per-principal/document and aggregate fair admission; no callback blocking or second Studio scheduler.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.finding: LedgerDecorator spawn returns an error after a successful inner spawn if START recording fails; this inspected path has no compensating process kill before returning.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.counterexample: Inner spawn succeeds, ledger record_start fails, and caller receives SpawnFailed without the ProcessHandle. A plugin manager that treats this error as no live process can lose cleanup ownership. No live leak was executed or observed.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.remediation: Shared sandbox owner must retain/return cleanup ownership or kill/reap on ledger/state-registration failure; do not implement divergent recovery in each Studio provider.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.future_MT_proof: Inject START write and decorator-state failures after spawn; independently reconcile process registry, ledger and child lifetime; bounded reclamation and explicit cleanup failure diagnostics.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.finding: Studio plugin manifest and extension points must map to the shared platform contract without shadow capability, resource or storage authority.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.counterexample: A domain plugin writes a local KV store under plugin_id but ignores account/ResourceBroker grants, or imports raw asset paths into a private index. Namespacing alone does not preserve revocation, account isolation, CKC provenance or authoritative node undo.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.remediation: Define versioned shared-manifest mapping for the exact Studio fields and closed extension/event sets. Node data remains StudioDocument undo/CRDT/export state; plugin KV remains shared platform plugin+account resource storage; assets remain CKC/ArtifactService references.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.future_MT_proof: Manifest rejection for unknown/invalid required fields, namespace collision, changed requested caps, unauthorized network and cross-account KV; grant revoke after discovery; secret-pattern node rejection, undo/CRDT/export round trip; asset permissions checked on fresh canonical identities.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.finding: The native surface extension seam is explicitly design-only; installed plugin panels/commands and canonical Argus/UserManual propagation require real consumers.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.counterexample: A panel appears in a plugin-local UI and its headless command works in a mock, but canonical command discovery, Argus structured state and UserManual omit it. The foundation can be executable while production usability remains absent.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.remediation: Contributions feed the same namespaced command/control/diagnostic descriptors consumed by canonical UI, Argus and UserManual through host-neutral ports; isolate plugin UI with a typed channel and current authorization.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.future_MT_proof: Fresh installed command/manual/Argus reads agree; hidden/headless and panel execution share the gate; unknown or removed contribution is rejected; isolated UI cannot acquire ambient host access. Source inspection here does not establish a complete Argus plugin path.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.finding: ScorePlugin native audio hosting needs its own bounded foreign processing seam while registration, grants, library and sandbox ownership stay shared.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.counterexample: A shared platform grants activation, but an audio provider serializes state, retires foreign instances, loads libraries or allocates during the device callback. Platform authorization does not prove callback safety or safe unload lifetime.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.remediation: Expose immutable grant/identity/version/processing-state handles and bounded prepared blocks; state save/load, activation, retirement and deallocation run off callback under shared worker/process lifetime ownership. Public asset ports contain no handshake_core/native/SurrealDB imports.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.future_MT_proof: Real selected native host block processing with no callback allocation/blocking/state capture/foreign retirement; malformed plugin/crash/hang/unload races, stale version handle and revoked grant cases; isolated asset build closure separately from actual kernel embedding.
